q.en: You reach the red octagon sign shown. What must you do?
q.zh: 你来到图中所示的红色八角形标志前。你必须怎么做？

en: Come to a complete stop before the crosswalk or stop line, then yield and go carefully
Slow down and go if the way looks clear
Stop only if another vehicle is waiting
Sound your horn and proceed slowly
zh: 完全停稳在人行横道或停车线之前，然后让行再小心通过
减速，没车就可以通过
只有其他车辆在等待时才停车
鸣笛后缓慢通过

explanation.en: A STOP sign requires a complete halt for every vehicle; slowing down is not enough.
explanation.zh: 停车标志要求每辆车完全停稳；只是减速是不够的。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Traffic Signs: Stop and Yield Signs

q.en: A STOP sign has a small plaque underneath reading 4-WAY. What does that change?
q.zh: 停车标志下有一块写着 4-WAY 的小牌。这改变了什么？

en: Only the first driver must stop
Traffic from all directions must stop; the first vehicle to stop goes first
You may roll through if you arrived first
The speed limit becomes 4 mph
zh: 只有第一辆车必须停车
各个方向的车辆都必须停车；先停稳的车辆先走
先到就可以慢行通过
限速变为 4 英里/小时

explanation.en: With a 4-WAY or ALL WAY plaque, all traffic approaching the intersection must stop.
explanation.zh: 有 4-WAY 或 ALL WAY 牌时，各个方向驶来的车辆都必须停车。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Traffic Signs: Stop and Yield Signs

q.en: What does the triangular yield sign shown require you to do?
q.zh: 图中所示的三角形让行标志要求你怎么做？

en: Stop in all cases, even with no traffic near
Speed up to merge before others
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians go first
Treat it as a guide sign with no action needed
zh: 任何情况下都要停车，哪怕附近没有车辆
加速，在别人之前汇入
减速并做好停车准备，让车辆、骑行者和行人先行
把它当作指路标志，无需任何动作

explanation.en: At a yield sign you slow down and stop completely if traffic conditions require it.
explanation.zh: 在让行标志前要减速；交通情况需要时必须完全停稳。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Traffic Signs: Stop and Yield Signs

q.en: The sign shown is a red square with a white horizontal bar and the words DO NOT ENTER. What does it mean?
q.zh: 图中所示标志是红底、白横杠并写着 DO NOT ENTER（禁止驶入）。它是什么意思？

en: Trucks may not enter, but cars may
Parking is not allowed on this street
The road ahead is closed to pedestrians only
You must not drive into this roadway from this direction
zh: 卡车不得驶入，但小汽车可以
这条街禁止停车
前方道路仅对行人封闭
你不得从这个方向驶入这条道路

explanation.en: This regulatory sign bars vehicles from entering the roadway in the direction facing the sign.
explanation.zh: 这个禁令标志禁止车辆朝标志所面对的方向驶入道路。

q.en: You turn onto a street and immediately see the WRONG WAY sign shown. What should you do?
q.zh: 你刚拐上一条街就看到图中所示的 WRONG WAY（逆行）标志。你应该怎么做？

en: Keep driving carefully until the next intersection
Flash your headlights and continue slowly
Move into the left lane and proceed
Stop, pull over, and turn around when it is safe — you are going against traffic
zh: 小心驾驶到下一个路口
闪烁大灯后缓慢继续
驶入左侧车道继续行驶
停车靠边，在安全时掉头——你正在逆行

explanation.en: A WRONG WAY sign warns that you are traveling against the flow of traffic.
explanation.zh: WRONG WAY 标志警告你正在逆着车流方向行驶。

q.en: What does the ONE WAY sign shown tell you?
q.zh: 图中所示的 ONE WAY（单行道）标志告诉你什么？

en: You may park on only one side of the street
Traffic on this street moves in one direction only, the direction of the arrow
Only one vehicle may use the street at a time
The street has only one lane for parking
zh: 这条街只能在一侧停车
这条街的车流只能按箭头方向单向行驶
这条街一次只能有一辆车通行
这条街只有一条停车道

explanation.en: A one-way sign means all traffic moves only in the direction the arrow points.
explanation.zh: 单行道标志表示所有车辆只能按箭头所指方向行驶。

q.en: The sign shown reads SPEED LIMIT 25. How should you treat that number?
q.zh: 图中所示标志写着 SPEED LIMIT 25（限速 25）。你应如何理解这个数字？

en: As the minimum speed in all conditions
As the speed you must maintain exactly
As the fastest you may go under ideal conditions — slower when conditions are poor
As a suggestion that applies only at night
zh: 任何情况下的最低速度
必须始终保持的精确速度
理想条件下的最高速度——路况差时要更慢
仅在夜间适用的建议

explanation.en: Posted limits assume ideal conditions; poor conditions require a slower speed.
explanation.zh: 标示限速以理想条件为前提；路况差时必须放慢。

q.en: A sign shows a left-turn arrow inside a red circle with a diagonal slash. What is prohibited?
q.zh: 一个标志上，左转箭头位于红色圆圈内并带斜杠。禁止的是什么？

en: Turning left
Turning right
Parking on the left side
Left turns only during rush hour
zh: 左转
右转
在左侧停车
仅高峰时段左转

explanation.en: A red circle with a diagonal slash over a symbol means that action is prohibited.
explanation.zh: 红圈加斜杠覆盖在符号上，表示禁止该动作。

q.en: You see the NO U-TURN sign shown at an intersection. What applies?
q.zh: 你在路口看到图中所示的禁止掉头标志。哪项正确？

en: U-turns are allowed only at night
You may not make a U-turn here
You may U-turn if no police officer is present
Three-point turns are also banned everywhere in the state
zh: 仅夜间可以掉头
此处不得掉头
没有警察在场就可以掉头
全州范围内也禁止三点掉头

explanation.en: Where a NO U-TURN sign is posted, a U-turn is not allowed.
explanation.zh: 设有禁止掉头标志的地方不得掉头。

q.en: A NO PARKING sign lists hours underneath. What does it mean for those hours?
q.zh: 一个禁止停车标志下方标有时间段。在该时间段内意味着什么？

en: Parking is allowed for 15 minutes
Only residents may park
You may not park in that zone during the posted hours
You may stop but never load passengers
zh: 可以停 15 分钟
只有居民可以停车
在标示时段内不得在该区域停车
可以停车但绝不能载客

explanation.en: Parking is barred in a zone posted with a NO PARKING sign during the hours shown.
explanation.zh: 在标示时段内，设有禁止停车标志的区域不得停车。

q.en: The yellow diamond sign shown pictures a person walking. What is it warning you about?
q.zh: 图中所示黄色菱形标志上画着一个行人。它在警告什么？

en: A bus stop is ahead
A sidewalk ends ahead
Jogging is prohibited ahead
Pedestrians may be crossing ahead — be ready to yield or stop
zh: 前方有公交车站
前方人行道结束
前方禁止慢跑
前方可能有行人过街——做好让行或停车准备

explanation.en: This warning sign marks an area where pedestrians cross; drivers must yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk.
explanation.zh: 这个警告标志标示行人过街区域；驾驶员必须给人行横道内的行人让行。

q.en: You see the school crossing sign shown, with an arrow pointing down at a crosswalk. What should you expect?
q.zh: 你看到图中所示的学校过街标志，箭头向下指向人行横道。你应预期什么？

en: Children crossing at the marked crosswalk — slow down and watch carefully
A school bus stop with no children
A playground with no road access
A 40 mph school speed limit
zh: 有儿童在标示的人行横道过街——减速并仔细观察
没有学生的校车站
没有道路出入口的操场
学校限速 40 英里/小时

explanation.en: School crossing signs warn that children cross at the crosswalk the arrow indicates.
explanation.zh: 学校过街标志警告：箭头所指的人行横道有儿童过街。

q.en: At the tracks themselves you see a white X-shaped sign with the words RAILROAD CROSSING. What is this sign called and what does it mark?
q.zh: 在铁轨处你看到一个白色 X 形、写着 RAILROAD CROSSING 的标志。它叫什么、标示什么？

en: A yield sign; it marks a merge point
A crossbuck; it marks the point where the tracks cross the road
A crosswalk sign; it marks where trains stop
A guide sign; it marks the nearest station
zh: 让行标志；标示汇合点
十字架标（crossbuck）；标示铁轨与道路的交叉点
人行横道标志；标示火车停靠点
指路标志；标示最近的车站

explanation.en: The white crossbuck marks the crossing point; a number below it shows how many tracks cross if there is more than one.
explanation.zh: 白色十字架标标示交叉点；若有多条铁轨，下方会标明铁轨数量。

q.en: You pass a round yellow warning sign with a black X and the letter R on each side. What lies ahead?
q.zh: 你经过一个圆形黄色警告标志，上面有黑色 X 且两侧各有一个字母 R。前方有什么？

en: A rest area
A road-rail junction in a rural area
A railroad crossing — slow down and be ready to stop
A rotary that requires a right turn
zh: 休息区
乡村地区的道路铁路交汇口
铁路道口——减速并做好停车准备
必须右转的环岛

explanation.en: A round sign is the advance warning for a railroad crossing.
explanation.zh: 圆形标志是铁路道口的预告警告标志。

q.en: The sign shown has an arrow bending to the right. What is ahead and what should you do?
q.zh: 图中所示标志上的箭头向右弯曲。前方是什么情况，你应怎么做？

en: The road curves right — slow down before the curve
A right turn is required at the next street
Traffic must merge right immediately
The right lane ends at a curve
zh: 道路向右弯曲——入弯前减速
下一条街必须右转
车辆必须立即向右汇合
右侧车道在弯道处结束

explanation.en: A curve warning means the road layout is changing ahead; slow down and obey the sign.
explanation.zh: 弯道警告表示前方道路走向有变化；要减速并遵守标志。

q.en: A warning sign shows an arrow making a sharp hairpin-style turn. How is this different from a regular curve sign?
q.zh: 一个警告标志上的箭头呈现急发夹式转弯。它与普通弯道标志有何不同？

en: It means the turn is optional
It marks a turn so sharp you must slow down much more than for a gentle curve
It applies only to trucks
It means the road is closed to through traffic
zh: 它表示可以不转弯
它表示转弯很急，必须比缓弯减速更多
它仅适用于卡车
它表示道路禁止直行车辆通行

explanation.en: A sharp-turn warning calls for a much lower speed than a gentle curve.
explanation.zh: 急转弯警告要求比缓弯低得多的速度。

q.en: The sign shown pictures a car with squiggly lines behind its tires. What does it warn?
q.zh: 图中所示标志画着一辆车，轮胎后有波浪线。它警告什么？

en: A car wash is nearby
Tire chains are sold ahead
The road is slippery when wet — slow down and keep extra space
The shoulder is soft dirt
zh: 附近有洗车店
前方有售防滑链
路面湿滑——减速并拉大车距
路肩是松软泥土

explanation.en: This sign warns the road can be slippery when wet.
explanation.zh: 这个标志警告路面湿时容易打滑。

q.en: You see the merge sign shown on a highway entrance area. What is happening ahead?
q.zh: 你在高速公路入口附近看到图中所示的汇合标志。前方是什么情况？

en: Your lane is ending at a toll booth
Two roads cross at a traffic light
A divided highway begins
Traffic from another lane or ramp is joining — adjust speed and space to merge safely
zh: 你的车道将在收费站结束
两条道路在红绿灯处相交
分隔式公路开始
其他车道或匝道的车流正在汇入——调整速度和车距以安全汇合

explanation.en: A merge sign warns that lanes are coming together; drivers must blend in safely.
explanation.zh: 汇合标志警告车道正在合并；驾驶员必须安全汇入。

q.en: After a divided stretch, you see the two-way traffic sign shown (two arrows pointing opposite directions). What changes?
q.zh: 经过一段分隔道路后，你看到图中所示的双向交通标志（两个箭头方向相反）。有什么变化？

en: You must now share the roadway with oncoming traffic
Passing becomes allowed everywhere
The road becomes one-way in both directions at different hours
Trucks must use the left lane
zh: 你现在要与对向车流共用道路
到处都允许超车
道路在不同时段双向单行
卡车必须走左侧车道

explanation.en: The sign warns that the road ahead carries traffic in both directions.
explanation.zh: 该标志警告前方道路为双向行驶。

q.en: The sign shown has two arrows separated by a median strip. What does it announce?
q.zh: 图中所示标志有两个被中央分隔带隔开的箭头。它预告什么？

en: A road with two toll lanes begins
A divided highway begins — opposing traffic will be separated by a median
Two one-way streets merge into one
A highway rest area with two entrances
zh: 一条有两条收费车道的道路开始
分隔式公路开始——对向车流将被中央带隔开
两条单行道合为一条
有两个入口的高速公路休息区

explanation.en: This warning sign tells you the road ahead becomes a divided highway.
explanation.zh: 这个警告标志告诉你前方道路将变为分隔式公路。

q.en: The sign shown pictures a traffic light. What should you be prepared for?
q.zh: 图中所示标志画着一个红绿灯。你应做好什么准备？

en: A railroad signal that is out of service
A signal to change lanes
A traffic signal ahead — be ready to stop if it is red
A school zone with no signal
zh: 一个停用的铁路信号
变道信号
前方有交通信号灯——若是红灯要做好停车准备
没有信号灯的学校区域

explanation.en: A traffic-signal-ahead warning means a signal is coming up and you may need to stop.
explanation.zh: 前方信号灯警告表示前面有信号灯，可能需要停车。

q.en: You see a warning sign with the word STOP and an upward arrow. What is it telling you?
q.zh: 你看到一个写着 STOP 并带向上箭头的警告标志。它在告诉你什么？

en: A stop sign is ahead — be ready to come to a complete stop
Stop only if you are turning
Restrooms are available ahead
A vehicle inspection stop is ahead
zh: 前方有停车标志——做好完全停稳的准备
仅在转弯时才需停车
前方有洗手间
前方有车辆检查站

explanation.en: A stop-ahead sign warns that a STOP sign is coming so you can slow down in time.
explanation.zh: 前方停车预告标志提醒前面有停车标志，以便你及时减速。

q.en: The sign shown pictures a leaping deer. Where is this warning most relevant and what should you do?
q.zh: 图中所示标志画着一只跳跃的鹿。这个警告在何时最需注意，你应怎么做？

en: Near zoos only; honk as you pass
At hunting areas; speed up to clear the area
Near farms; watch only for cattle
In areas where deer cross the road — slow down and scan both sides, especially at dawn and dusk
zh: 仅在动物园附近；经过时鸣笛
在狩猎区；加速通过
在农场附近；只注意牛
在鹿穿越道路的区域——减速并扫视两侧，尤其在黎明和黄昏

explanation.en: A deer crossing sign warns that animals may enter the roadway; slow down and stay alert.
explanation.zh: 鹿穿越标志警告动物可能进入道路；要减速并保持警惕。

q.en: You approach a work area marked by orange signs and devices. What is the first thing you must do?
q.zh: 你接近一个由橙色标志和设施标示的施工区。你必须做的第一件事是什么？

en: Speed up to clear the zone quickly
Turn on high beams
Slow down and look for guidance on how to travel through the area
Change lanes without signaling to avoid workers
zh: 加速快速通过施工区
打开远光灯
减速并寻找如何通过该区域的指引
不打信号变道以避开工人

explanation.en: Orange means construction or maintenance warning; the first action in a work zone is to slow down.
explanation.zh: 橙色表示施工或养护警告；进入施工区的第一个动作是减速。

q.en: A fluorescent yellow-green sign shows a bicycle symbol. What does the color and symbol together signal?
q.zh: 一个荧光黄绿色标志上有自行车符号。颜色与符号合起来表示什么？

en: A bicycle shop is nearby
Bicycles are prohibited here
A bicycle race is in progress
A bicycle-related warning — watch for bicyclists, for example at a crossing or shared roadway
zh: 附近有自行车店
此处禁止自行车
正在进行自行车比赛
与自行车相关的警告——注意骑行者，如在过街处或共用道路

explanation.en: Fluorescent yellow-green is used for school, bicycle, and pedestrian warnings.
explanation.zh: 荧光黄绿色用于学校、自行车和行人相关的警告。

q.en: The sign shown indicates the right lane ends. What must traffic in that lane do?
q.zh: 图中所示标志表示右侧车道结束。该车道的车辆必须怎么做？

en: Merge safely into the continuing lane, yielding as needed
Stop until waved through
Turn right at the next corner only
Move onto the shoulder and keep driving
zh: 安全汇入继续延伸的车道，必要时让行
停车直到有人挥手放行
只能在下一个路口右转
驶上路肩继续行驶

explanation.en: When a lane ends (the road narrows), drivers in the ending lane merge into the remaining lane.
explanation.zh: 车道结束（道路变窄）时，该车道的驾驶员要汇入剩余车道。

q.en: The sign shown has arrows moving in a circle. What is ahead, and how do you enter it?
q.zh: 图中所示标志的箭头呈环形运动。前方是什么，你应如何驶入？

en: A rotary detour; enter at full speed
A circular intersection — slow down, yield to traffic already circulating and to pedestrians, then enter
A U-turn area; enter from the left lane only
A parking circle; no yielding is required
zh: 环岛绕行道；全速驶入
环形路口——减速，让已在环内行驶的车辆和行人先行，然后驶入
掉头区；只能从左侧车道驶入
停车圆环；无需让行

explanation.en: Circular intersections are entered after yielding to vehicles already in the circle and to pedestrians.
explanation.zh: 驶入环形路口前，要让已在环内的车辆和行人先行。

q.en: On Massachusetts signs, what does the color orange generally indicate?
q.zh: 在马萨诸塞州的标志中，橙色一般表示什么？

en: Motorist services such as gas and food
Recreation or historic sites
Construction or maintenance warning
Electronic toll collection
zh: 加油、餐饮等驾车者服务
娱乐或历史景点
施工或养护警告
电子收费

explanation.en: Orange is the color for construction and maintenance warnings.
explanation.zh: 橙色是施工和养护警告的颜色。

q.en: A brown sign and a blue sign give different kinds of information. Which pairing is correct?
q.zh: 棕色标志和蓝色标志提供不同种类的信息。哪一组配对正确？

en: Brown = recreational, historic, or scenic sites; blue = motorist services like gas, food, and lodging
Brown = regulation; blue = warning
Brown = toll roads; blue = school zones
Brown = direction; blue = stop or prohibition
zh: 棕色＝娱乐、历史或风景景点；蓝色＝加油、餐饮、住宿等驾车者服务
棕色＝禁令；蓝色＝警告
棕色＝收费道路；蓝色＝学校区域
棕色＝方向；蓝色＝停车或禁止

explanation.en: Blue signs list motorist services; brown signs point to recreational, historic, or scenic sites.
explanation.zh: 蓝色标志列出驾车者服务；棕色标志指向娱乐、历史或风景点。

q.en: It is raining hard on a highway posted at 50 mph, and 40 mph already feels too fast for conditions. What does the fundamental speed law require?
q.zh: 在限速 50 英里/小时的高速公路上雨下得很大，40 英里/小时对当前路况都已太快。基本速度法要求什么？

en: Keep at 50 mph because that is the posted limit
Slow down — your speed must fit traffic, road, and weather conditions even if the limit is higher
Drive 40 mph exactly, since another driver suggested it
Turn on hazard lights and keep the posted speed
zh: 保持 50 英里/小时，因为那是标示限速
减速——即使限速更高，你的速度也必须适应交通、道路和天气条件
正好开 40 英里/小时，因为别人这样建议
打开双闪并保持标示限速

explanation.en: You must never travel faster than is safe for conditions, regardless of the posted limit.
explanation.zh: 无论标示限速多少，都不得开得比路况安全所允许的更快。

q.en: No speed limit is posted on a road through a thickly settled district in a town that has NOT adopted a 25 mph local limit. Above what speed would your driving be unreasonable and improper?
q.zh: 在未采用 25 英里/小时地方限速的城镇，一条穿过人口稠密区的道路没有限速标志。超过多少速度会被视为不合理、不适当？

en: 20 mph
25 mph
30 mph
40 mph
zh: 20 英里/小时
25 英里/小时
30 英里/小时
40 英里/小时

explanation.en: Unless posted otherwise, over 30 mph in a thickly settled or business district is unreasonable.
explanation.zh: 除非另有标示，在人口稠密区或商业区超过 30 英里/小时即属不合理。

q.en: Some Massachusetts communities set their thickly settled speed limit at 25 mph unless posted otherwise. How do you know when you enter one?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞州一些社区将人口稠密区限速定为 25 英里/小时（除非另有标示）。你如何知道自己进入了这样的社区？

en: A text message is sent to your phone
The road surface changes color
Only local residents are told
Signs are posted at all entrances to the city or town
zh: 你的手机会收到短信
路面颜色会改变
只有当地居民会被告知
城镇所有入口处都设有标志

explanation.en: Communities using the 25 mph thickly settled limit post signs at every entrance.
explanation.zh: 采用 25 英里/小时人口稠密区限速的社区在每个入口都设有标志。

q.en: What counts as a 'thickly settled district' in Massachusetts?
q.zh: 在马萨诸塞州，什么才算“人口稠密区”？

en: An area where buildings are less than 200 feet apart for a distance of one-quarter mile or more
Any area with a traffic light
Any street with parked cars on both sides
An area inside a city border
zh: 建筑物间距小于 200 英尺且连续达四分之一英里或以上的区域
任何有红绿灯的区域
两侧都有停车的任何街道
市界以内的区域

explanation.en: A thickly settled district has buildings under 200 feet apart for at least a quarter mile.
explanation.zh: 人口稠密区指建筑间距小于 200 英尺、连续达四分之一英里以上的区域。

q.en: What is the speed limit in a Massachusetts school zone?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞州学校区域的限速是多少？

en: 15 mph
20 mph
25 mph
30 mph
zh: 15 英里/小时
20 英里/小时
25 英里/小时
30 英里/小时

explanation.en: Roads near schools carry a 20 mph limit in a school zone.
explanation.zh: 学校附近道路在学校区域内限速 20 英里/小时。

q.en: Outside a thickly settled or business district, and with nothing posted, above what speed is driving on a highway considered unreasonable?
q.zh: 在人口稠密区或商业区之外、且没有任何标志的高速公路上，超过多少速度会被视为不合理？

en: 40 mph
45 mph
50 mph
55 mph
zh: 40 英里/小时
45 英里/小时
50 英里/小时
55 英里/小时

explanation.en: The unposted benchmarks are 40 mph off-highway and 50 mph on a highway outside thickly settled districts.
explanation.zh: 无标志时的基准是：非高速公路 40 英里/小时，人口稠密区外的高速公路 50 英里/小时。

q.en: What is the minimum speed on the Massachusetts Turnpike?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞收费公路（Massachusetts Turnpike）的最低限速是多少？

en: 40 mph
20 mph
30 mph
45 mph
zh: 40 英里/小时
20 英里/小时
30 英里/小时
45 英里/小时

explanation.en: The Turnpike minimum is 40 mph; Boston Harbor tunnels have a 20 mph minimum.
explanation.zh: 收费公路最低限速为 40 英里/小时；波士顿海港隧道最低为 20 英里/小时。

q.en: Limited-access highways in Massachusetts, such as interstate routes, generally carry speed limits in what range?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞州的有限出入高速公路（如州际公路）通常限速范围是多少？

en: 35 to 45 mph
50 to 65 mph
45 to 55 mph
65 to 75 mph
zh: 35 至 45 英里/小时
50 至 65 英里/小时
45 至 55 英里/小时
65 至 75 英里/小时

explanation.en: Limited-access highways run 50 to 65 mph; smaller highways are 55 mph or lower.
explanation.zh: 有限出入高速公路为 50 至 65 英里/小时；较小的公路为 55 英里/小时或更低。

q.en: You stop at a steady red light and want to turn right. When may you go?
q.zh: 你在 steady red（持续红灯）前停下想右转。什么时候可以走？

en: Immediately, if you honk first
Only when the light turns green
After a complete stop, yielding to pedestrians and other vehicles — and never if a NO TURN ON RED sign is posted
After slowing to 5 mph and looking once
zh: 先鸣笛就可以立即走
只能等绿灯亮起
完全停稳后，让行人和其它车辆先行——且有 NO TURN ON RED 标志时绝不能转
减速到 5 英里/小时看一眼就可以

explanation.en: Right on red is allowed after stopping and yielding, unless a NO TURN ON RED sign prohibits it.
explanation.zh: 停稳并让行后可以红灯右转，但有 NO TURN ON RED 标志时禁止。

q.en: When is a left turn on a red light allowed in Massachusetts?
q.zh: 在马萨诸塞州，什么时候允许红灯左转？

en: From any street onto a one-way street
Never — left on red is always illegal
Only when a police officer waves you through a red light at night
Only from a one-way street onto another one-way street, after stopping and yielding
zh: 从任何街道转入单行道都可以
绝不允许——红灯左转一律违法
仅当警察在夜间挥手示意通过红灯时
仅当从一条单行道转入另一条单行道时，停稳并让行后可以

explanation.en: Left on red is allowed only one-way onto one-way, after a stop and yield.
explanation.zh: 只有从单行道转入单行道时，才可在停稳让行后红灯左转。

q.en: The traffic light ahead is flashing red. How must you treat it?
q.zh: 前方交通灯在闪烁红灯。你应如何对待？

en: The same as a STOP sign: come to a complete stop, obey right-of-way rules, and go when safe
Like a yield sign — slow down only
Like a green light after one look
Stop only if cross traffic is present
zh: 与停车标志相同：完全停稳，遵守路权规则，安全时再走
像让行标志一样——只需减速
看一眼就当绿灯
只有横向有车时才停车

explanation.en: A flashing red circle means the same as a STOP sign.
explanation.zh: 闪烁红灯与停车标志含义相同。

q.en: You approach a steady yellow light and can stop safely before the intersection. What must you do?
q.zh: 你接近持续黄灯，且能在路口前安全停下。你必须怎么做？

en: Speed up to beat the red
Proceed because yellow means go faster
Stop only if a pedestrian is crossing
Stop — the signal is changing from green to red
zh: 加速抢在红灯前通过
继续行驶，因为黄灯表示加速
只有行人在过街时才停车
停车——信号正在由绿变红

explanation.en: Steady yellow means the light is about to turn red; stop if you can do so safely.
explanation.zh: 持续黄灯表示即将变红灯；能安全停下时必须停车。

q.en: All the traffic signals at an intersection are dark and not functioning. How do you proceed?
q.zh: 路口所有信号灯都熄灭、不工作。你应如何通行？

en: As if it were a green light for your direction
As a yield for side streets only
As though there is a stop sign in all directions — stop and go when safe
Drive through slowly without stopping
zh: 当作你方向是绿灯
仅对支路是让行
当作各个方向都有停车标志——停车，安全时再走
不停车缓慢通过

explanation.en: Blacked-out signals are treated like an all-way stop.
explanation.zh: 信号灯熄灭时按全向停车处理。

q.en: On a steady green light you want to turn left. What must you do first?
q.zh: 在持续绿灯时你想左转。你必须先做什么？

en: Yield to oncoming traffic, and watch for pedestrians and bicyclists
Turn quickly before oncoming traffic moves
Sound your horn and turn
Wait for a green arrow in all cases
zh: 让对向车辆先行，并注意行人和骑行者
在对向车辆动起来之前快速转弯
鸣笛后转弯
任何情况下都要等绿色箭头

explanation.en: A left turn on a steady green requires yielding to oncoming traffic.
explanation.zh: 持续绿灯左转必须让对向车辆先行。

q.en: A broken white line separates lanes beside you. What does it allow?
q.zh: 你旁边车道之间是白色虚线。它允许什么？

en: Passing in the opposite direction
Lane changes in the same direction after you signal and check it is safe
Parking in the lane
Crossing only for trucks
zh: 在对向超车
打信号并确认安全后，在同向车道间变道
在车道内停车
仅卡车可以跨越

explanation.en: Broken white lines separate same-direction lanes and may be crossed to change lanes when safe.
explanation.zh: 白色虚线分隔同向车道，安全时可跨越变道。

q.en: Both lines of a double yellow center line are solid. What is prohibited, and what is still allowed?
q.zh: 中央双黄线都是实线。禁止什么，仍允许什么？

en: All crossing is banned, including turns
Passing is allowed but turns are banned
Crossing to pass another vehicle is banned; crossing for a left turn is allowed when safe
Nothing changes — the lines are only guides
zh: 禁止一切跨越，包括转弯
允许超车但禁止转弯
禁止跨越超车；安全时可跨越左转
没有任何变化——线条只是参考

explanation.en: Double solid yellow lines bar passing, but a left turn across them is permitted when safe.
explanation.zh: 双黄实线禁止超车，但安全时可以跨越左转。

q.en: A center line pair has a solid yellow line on your side and a broken yellow line on the far side. May you cross to pass?
q.zh: 中央线组中你这一侧是黄实线、另一侧是黄虚线。你可以跨越超车吗？

en: Yes, whenever traffic is light
Yes, because one side is broken
Passing is allowed for both sides at night
Only the traffic on the broken-line side may cross to pass; your side may not
zh: 只要车少就可以
可以，因为有一侧是虚线
夜间两侧都可以超车
只有虚线一侧的车辆可以跨越超车；你这一侧不可以

explanation.en: With solid-plus-broken yellow, passing is allowed only from the broken-line side.
explanation.zh: 黄实线加黄虚线时，只有虚线一侧可以超车。

q.en: What does a white diamond painted on a lane tell you?
q.zh: 车道上画着白色菱形表示什么？

en: The lane has a special restriction, such as HOV only or bus only
The lane is ending
The lane is for parking
The lane is a bicycle lane
zh: 该车道有特殊限制，如仅限高载客车辆或仅限公交
车道即将结束
该车道用于停车
该车道是自行车道

explanation.en: A white diamond marks a restricted lane such as a high-occupancy-vehicle or bus lane.
explanation.zh: 白色菱形标示限制车道，如高载客车辆专用或公交专用。

q.en: Two cars reach a four-way stop at exactly the same moment. Who goes first?
q.zh: 两辆车同时到达四向停车路口。谁先走？

en: The larger vehicle
The driver on the right — yield to the vehicle stopped to your right
The driver on the left
The driver who honks first
zh: 较大的车辆
右侧的驾驶员——你要让已在你右侧停稳的车辆先行
左侧的驾驶员
先鸣笛的驾驶员

explanation.en: At a four-way stop, vehicles go in the order they stopped; if simultaneous, yield to your right.
explanation.zh: 四向停车时按停稳顺序通行；同时到达则让右侧车辆先行。

q.en: At an intersection with no signs or signals, a car approaches from your right. What must you do?
q.zh: 在一个没有标志或信号的路口，一辆车从你右侧驶来。你必须怎么做？

en: Speed up to clear first
Turn on high beams and proceed
Yield the right-of-way to the vehicle coming from your right
The other driver always yields to you
zh: 加速先通过
打开远光灯后继续
给从你右侧驶来的车辆让行
对方永远要让你

explanation.en: At an uncontrolled intersection you yield to a vehicle that has entered, or is coming, from your right.
explanation.zh: 在无控制路口，要让已从你右侧驶入或正从右侧驶来的车辆先行。

q.en: You are pulling out of a driveway onto a paved street. What must you do before entering?
q.zh: 你正从车道驶入一条铺装街道。进入之前必须怎么做？

en: Honk and pull out slowly
Yield only to vehicles, not pedestrians
Enter quickly so traffic can adjust
Stop, then yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and vehicles on the road you are entering
zh: 鸣笛后缓慢驶出
只让车辆，不让行人
快速驶入让其它车辆适应
先停车，然后让行人、骑行者和你要进入道路上的车辆先行

explanation.en: Entering a paved road from a driveway, private road, or unpaved road requires a stop and yielding.
explanation.zh: 从车道、私人道路或未铺装道路进入铺装道路时必须停车并让行。

q.en: Traffic in a Massachusetts rotary travels which way, and who yields at the entrance?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞州环岛（rotary）内的车流朝哪个方向行驶，入口处谁让行？

en: Clockwise; drivers inside yield to entering traffic
Counterclockwise; entering drivers yield to vehicles already in the rotary and to pedestrians
Counterclockwise; no one yields
Clockwise; pedestrians yield to all cars
zh: 顺时针；环内驾驶员让进入的车辆
逆时针；进入的驾驶员让已在环内的车辆和行人先行
逆时针；谁都不让
顺时针；行人让所有车辆

explanation.en: Rotary traffic moves counterclockwise, and yield signs at entrances require yielding to traffic already inside.
explanation.zh: 环岛车流逆时针行驶，入口让行标志要求让已在环内的车辆先行。

q.en: How far in advance must you signal a turn on an ordinary street, and on a highway?
q.zh: 在普通街道和高速公路上，分别要提前多远打转弯信号？

en: 50 feet on streets; 200 feet on highways
Signal only as you begin the turn
100 feet on streets; 500 feet on highways
200 feet everywhere
zh: 街道 50 英尺；高速 200 英尺
开始转弯时才打
街道 100 英尺；高速 500 英尺
任何地方都是 200 英尺

explanation.en: Signal at least 100 feet before a turn, and at least 500 feet before a turn on a highway.
explanation.zh: 转弯前至少提前 100 英尺打信号；高速公路上至少 500 英尺。

q.en: You want to make a U-turn near the crest of a hill where neither you nor others can see 500 feet. What applies?
q.zh: 你想在山顶附近掉头，而你和他人都看不到 500 英尺外。这种情况如何处理？

en: Allowed if you signal early
Allowed at night with headlights on
Allowed only for small cars
Not allowed — never U-turn where visibility is under 500 feet, such as at a hill crest or near a curve
zh: 提前打信号就可以
夜间开大灯就可以
仅小型车可以
不允许——在视距不足 500 英尺处（如山顶或弯道附近）绝不能掉头

explanation.en: U-turns are barred where drivers cannot see 500 feet, and only from the lane closest to the center line.
explanation.zh: 在视距不足 500 英尺的地方禁止掉头，且只能从最靠近中央线的车道掉头。

q.en: You miss your highway exit. What is the correct response?
q.zh: 你错过了高速公路出口。正确做法是什么？

en: Continue to the next exit and rejoin in the other direction from there
Stop in the breakdown lane and back up
Cross the median to the exit ramp
Slow down and wait for a gap to reverse
zh: 继续到下一个出口，再从那里返回另一方向
在应急车道停车并倒车
穿过中央带去出口匝道
减速并等空隙倒车

explanation.en: Never stop or back up on a highway after missing an exit; use the next exit.
explanation.zh: 错过出口后绝不能在高速公路上停车或倒车；走下一个出口。

q.en: To pass on a two-way road by crossing a broken yellow line, how much clear view ahead do you need, and when must you be back in your lane?
q.zh: 在双向道路上跨越黄虚线超车时，你需要多远的清晰视距，又必须在何时回到车道？

en: 200 feet of view; return when convenient
400 feet of clear view; return before any oncoming vehicle comes within 200 feet
500 feet of view; return within 100 feet of oncoming traffic
100 feet of view; no set return distance
zh: 200 英尺视距；方便时返回
400 英尺清晰视距；在对向车辆距你 200 英尺以内之前返回
500 英尺视距；在对向车辆 100 英尺内返回
100 英尺视距；没有规定返回距离

explanation.en: Passing across a broken yellow line requires seeing at least 400 feet ahead and returning before oncoming traffic is within 200 feet.
explanation.zh: 跨黄虚线超车需至少 400 英尺清晰视距，并在对向车辆进入 200 英尺之前返回。

q.en: Another driver is passing your vehicle. What must you do?
q.zh: 另一名驾驶员正在超越你的车辆。你必须怎么做？

en: Speed up so they can finish faster
Move left to block them
Slow down and stay to the right so they can pass safely — do not speed up
Flash your lights repeatedly
zh: 加速让对方更快完成
向左移动挡住对方
减速并靠右，让对方安全通过——不要加速
反复闪灯

explanation.en: A driver being passed must slow down, stay right, and not speed up.
explanation.zh: 被超车时必须减速、靠右，并且不要加速。

q.en: Passing on the right is allowed in which set of situations?
q.zh: 在哪些情况下允许右侧超车？

en: When the vehicle ahead is making or about to make a left turn, on a one-way street, or on a road with one-direction multi-lane traffic — if the road is clear and wide enough
Any time the left lane is busy
On the shoulder or breakdown lane when traffic is slow
Whenever the driver ahead signals you to pass
zh: 当前车正在或即将左转时、在单行道上、或在单向多车道道路上——且道路畅通、足够宽
左侧车道繁忙时任何时候都可以
交通缓慢时走路肩或应急车道
只要前车驾驶员示意你超车

explanation.en: Right-side passing is limited to those situations; the shoulder, breakdown lane, and sidewalk may never be used for passing.
explanation.zh: 右侧超车仅限于这些情况；绝不能用路肩、应急车道或人行道超车。

q.en: Parking on a hill with no curb: which way should your front wheels point?
q.zh: 在没有路缘石的坡道上停车：前轮应朝向哪边？

en: Outward, toward the travel lane
Inward, toward the edge of the road
Straight ahead
It does not matter if the parking brake is set
zh: 向外，朝向行车道
向内，朝向路边
笔直向前
拉了手刹就无所谓

explanation.en: With no curb, turn wheels inward toward the road edge; always set the parking brake on a hill.
explanation.zh: 没有路缘石时，前轮向内朝向路边；在坡道上务必拉手刹。

q.en: How close to an intersection, and how close to a fire hydrant, may you legally park?
q.zh: 距路口多近、距消防栓多近停车是违法的界限？

en: Within 10 feet of an intersection; 20 feet of a hydrant
Within 30 feet of either
Within 20 feet of an intersection; 10 feet of a fire hydrant or fire lane
Parking near either is always allowed in residential areas
zh: 距路口 10 英尺内；距消防栓 20 英尺
距两者 30 英尺内
距路口 20 英尺内；距消防栓或消防通道 10 英尺内
在住宅区附近两者都可以停

explanation.en: Parking is barred within 20 feet of an intersection and within 10 feet of a hydrant or fire lane.
explanation.zh: 距路口 20 英尺内、距消防栓或消防通道 10 英尺内禁止停车。

q.en: Massachusetts law requires a safety belt (or child restraint) for whom?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞州法律要求谁系安全带（或使用儿童约束装置）？

en: Only the driver
Only front-seat passengers
Only passengers under 16
Every person in a passenger vehicle, including vans and small trucks under 18,000 pounds
zh: 只有驾驶员
只有前排乘客
只有 16 岁以下的乘客
乘用车辆内的每一个人，包括 18,000 磅以下的厢式车和小型卡车

explanation.en: Everyone riding in a passenger motor vehicle must be belted or in a child restraint.
explanation.zh: 乘用车辆内的所有人都必须系安全带或使用儿童约束装置。

q.en: Until when must a child ride in a federally approved child passenger restraint?
q.zh: 儿童必须使用经联邦批准的儿童乘员约束装置，直到什么时候？

en: Until at least 8 years old or at least 57 inches tall
Until age 5 or 40 inches tall
Until age 10 in all cases
Until the child can sit in the front seat
zh: 到至少 8 岁或身高至少 57 英寸
到 5 岁或身高 40 英寸
任何情况下到 10 岁
到孩子能坐前排为止

explanation.en: A child restraint is required until the child is at least eight years old or at least fifty-seven inches tall.
explanation.zh: 儿童约束装置要用至孩子至少 8 岁或身高至少 57 英寸。

q.en: What is the fine for a driver who is not wearing a safety belt (when stopped for a traffic violation)?
q.zh: 驾驶员未系安全带会被罚多少（在因交通违规被拦下时）？

zh: 10 美元
25 美元
50 美元
100 美元

explanation.en: The belt fine is $25; a passenger 16 or older who is unbelted can also be fined $25.
explanation.zh: 安全带罚款为 25 美元；16 岁以上未系安全带的乘客也可被罚 25 美元。

q.en: Where is the safest place for a child to ride, and what seat rule applies to rear-facing infant seats?
q.zh: 儿童乘车最安全的位置在哪里，后向婴儿座椅有什么规定？

en: Front seat; rear-facing seats are fine with an air bag
Any seat, as long as the belt is on
Back seat, middle if possible; never put a rear-facing seat in front of a passenger air bag
Behind the driver; air bags do not matter
zh: 前排；有安全气囊也可以用后向座椅
任何座位，只要系安全带
后排，最好是中间；绝不能把后向座椅放在乘客安全气囊前方
驾驶员后方；气囊没有影响

explanation.en: Children are safest in the back seat, and a rear-facing seat must never sit in front of an active passenger air bag.
explanation.zh: 儿童坐后排最安全，后向座椅绝不能放在启用的乘客安全气囊前方。

q.en: Using the three-second rule, you reach the marker the car ahead just passed after counting only 'one, two.' What does that tell you?
q.zh: 用三秒法则，你在数到“二”时就到达了前车刚经过的标记物。这说明什么？

en: You are too close — slow down until you have at least a three-second gap in good conditions
Your following distance is perfect
You should speed up to match traffic
The rule only applies on highways
zh: 你跟得太近——在良好路况下减速，拉开至少三秒的间隔
跟车距离刚好
你应加速与车流一致
该法则只适用于高速公路

explanation.en: Three seconds is the minimum following gap in good conditions; reaching the marker early means you are too close.
explanation.zh: 良好路况下三秒是最小跟车间隔；提前到达标记物说明跟得太近。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Safe Distances Around Your Car

q.en: How much following distance should you keep behind a motorcycle, and behind heavy equipment such as a dump truck?
q.zh: 跟在摩托车后面、跟在自卸车等重型设备后面，应分别保持多少跟车距离？

en: 2 seconds; 3 seconds
At least 4 seconds behind a motorcycle; at least 10 seconds behind heavy equipment
3 seconds for both
10 seconds for both
zh: 2 秒；3 秒
摩托车后至少 4 秒；重型设备后至少 10 秒
两者都是 3 秒
两者都是 10 秒

explanation.en: Use at least four seconds behind a motorcycle and at least ten seconds behind heavy equipment.
explanation.zh: 摩托车后至少 4 秒，重型设备后至少 10 秒。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Safe Distances Around Your Car

q.en: A driver is tailgating you closely. What is the safest response?
q.zh: 一名驾驶员紧贴你车尾行驶。最安全的应对是什么？

en: Brake sharply to warn them
Speed up well above the limit to escape
Move to another lane or pull to the side of the road and let the tailgater pass
Slow to half the speed limit and block them
zh: 急刹车警告对方
远超限速逃离
变道或靠边停下，让紧贴者先通过
减速到限速一半并挡住对方

explanation.en: If a tailgater is behind you, get out of their way and let them pass; tailgating itself is illegal.
explanation.zh: 被紧贴时要让开让对方通过；紧贴行驶本身是违法的。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Safe Distances Around Your Car

q.en: When must you dim your high beams for other traffic?
q.zh: 你必须在什么时候为其它车辆将远光灯调为近光？

en: Within 300 feet of an oncoming vehicle; 100 feet behind a vehicle
Only when the other driver flashes at you
Never on divided highways
Within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle, and within 200 feet of a vehicle traveling ahead of you
zh: 对向车辆 300 英尺内；前车后 100 英尺
只有对方闪灯时
在分隔式公路上从不
对向车辆 500 英尺内，以及前方同向车辆 200 英尺内

explanation.en: Dim high beams within 500 feet of oncoming traffic and within 200 feet behind a vehicle ahead.
explanation.zh: 对向车辆 500 英尺内、前方车辆 200 英尺内必须调为近光。

q.en: High beams normally let you see about how far ahead, compared with low beams?
q.zh: 远光灯通常能照多远，近光灯呢？

en: High ≈ 100 feet; low ≈ 350 feet
Both ≈ 500 feet
High ≈ 200 feet; low ≈ 50 feet
High ≈ 350 feet; low ≈ 100 feet
zh: 远光约 100 英尺；近光约 350 英尺
两者都约 500 英尺
远光约 200 英尺；近光约 50 英尺
远光约 350 英尺；近光约 100 英尺

explanation.en: High beams show roughly 350 feet ahead and low beams roughly 100 feet.
explanation.zh: 远光约照亮前方 350 英尺，近光约 100 英尺。

q.en: An oncoming driver will not dim their high beams and the glare is blinding you. What should you do?
q.zh: 对向驾驶员不调近光，眩光让你看不清。你应该怎么做？

en: Turn your own high beams on in return
Look to the lower right side of your lane and stay to the right
Close your eyes briefly and keep your speed
Look straight at their headlights to judge distance
zh: 也打开自己的远光灯回击
看向你车道的右下方并靠右行驶
短暂闭眼并保持速度
直视对方大灯判断距离

explanation.en: When blinded by glare, look to the lower right side of your lane rather than at the headlights.
explanation.zh: 被眩光影响时，看向车道右下方，而不是直视大灯。

q.en: In which of these situations must your headlights and taillights be on?
q.zh: 在下列哪种情况下必须打开大灯和尾灯？

en: Only on highways after midnight
Only in tunnels during the day
Whenever you use your windshield wipers, and from a half hour after sunset to a half hour before sunrise
Whenever passengers ask for them
zh: 仅在午夜后的高速公路上
仅在白天的隧道里
使用雨刮器时，以及日落后半小时至日出前半小时
乘客要求时

explanation.en: Headlights are required with wipers in use, at night as defined, when visibility is under 500 feet, and in tunnels; daytime running lights are not sufficient.
explanation.zh: 用雨刮时、规定的夜间时段、能见度不足 500 英尺时以及在隧道内都必须开灯；日间行车灯不够。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Using Your Horn, Headlights, and Emergency Signals

q.en: Your car begins to hydroplane on a wet road. What is the correct reaction?
q.zh: 你的车在湿滑路面上开始水滑（hydroplane）。正确反应是什么？

en: Slowly ease off the gas pedal; never hit the brakes or turn suddenly
Brake hard and turn away from traffic
Accelerate to regain tire contact
Steer sharply toward the shoulder
zh: 缓慢松开油门；绝不能猛踩刹车或急打方向
用力刹车并转向避开车流
加速以恢复轮胎抓地
急打方向冲向路肩

explanation.en: In a hydroplane, ease off the gas slowly; hard braking or sudden steering can cause a skid and loss of control.
explanation.zh: 发生水滑时要缓慢松油门；猛刹车或急打方向会导致打滑失控。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Driving in Rain or Fog / Winter Driving

q.en: In fog, which headlight setting should you use and why?
q.zh: 雾天应使用哪种灯光，为什么？

en: High beams, to see farther
Low beams, to reduce glare
Parking lights only
Hazard lights while moving at full speed
zh: 远光灯，能看得更远
近光灯，能减少眩光
仅驻车灯
全速行驶时开双闪

explanation.en: Low beams reduce glare in fog; slow down and be able to stop within the distance you can see.
explanation.zh: 雾天用近光可减少眩光；要减速并确保能在可见距离内停下。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Driving in Rain or Fog / Winter Driving

q.en: Which winter-driving fact about bridges is correct?
q.zh: 关于冬季驾驶中桥梁的哪项说法正确？

en: Bridges stay warmer than roads
Bridges are always sanded first, so they are safest
Bridges and overpasses freeze before the rest of the road because the ground does not insulate them
Bridge surfaces never ice over in Massachusetts
zh: 桥面比路面更暖
桥梁总是先撒沙，所以最安全
桥梁和高架先于其它路面结冰，因为地面无法为其保温
马萨诸塞州的桥面从不结冰

explanation.en: Bridges and highway overpasses freeze first and can be very slippery.
explanation.zh: 桥梁和高架最先结冰，可能非常滑。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Driving in Rain or Fog / Winter Driving

q.en: Before driving after a snowstorm, what must you clear from your vehicle?
q.zh: 暴风雪后开车前，你必须清除车辆上的什么？

en: Only the windshield
Only the roof
Snow removal is optional if you drive slowly
All ice and snow — windows, wipers, headlights, brake lights, roof, hood, and trunk
zh: 仅挡风玻璃
仅车顶
开慢点就可以不清除
所有冰雪——车窗、雨刮、大灯、刹车灯、车顶、引擎盖和行李箱

explanation.en: Failing to clear all snow and ice, including the roof, hood, and trunk, can be charged as negligent operation.
explanation.zh: 不清除包括车顶、引擎盖和行李箱在内的全部冰雪，可能被控疏忽驾驶。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Driving in Rain or Fog / Winter Driving

q.en: Under the Massachusetts hands-free law, a driver age 18 or older may use a phone while driving only if…
q.zh: 根据马萨诸塞州免提法，18 岁及以上驾驶员在驾驶时使用手机，必须满足……

en: The device is in hands-free mode, not held or supported, and mounted on the windshield, dashboard, or center console
It is held in one hand below window level
A passenger holds it up for the driver
It is used only on highways
zh: 设备处于免提模式、不被手持或托扶，并固定在挡风玻璃、仪表盘或中控台上
单手握持且低于车窗高度
由乘客替驾驶员举着
只在高速公路上使用

explanation.en: Adult drivers may only use devices hands-free; holding or supporting the device is not permitted.
explanation.zh: 成年驾驶员只能免提使用设备；不得手持或托扶设备。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Distracted Driving Law / Hands-Free Mobile (Cell) Phone Use

q.en: You are stopped at a red light. May you pick up your phone to read a text under the hands-free law?
q.zh: 你在红灯前停下。根据免提法，你可以拿起手机看短信吗？

en: Yes — a red light counts as parked
No — hand-held use is allowed only when the vehicle is stationary and not in a public travel lane, which a red light is not
Yes, if you keep one hand on the wheel
Yes, if the text is from family
zh: 可以——红灯算作停车
不可以——只有车辆静止且不在公共行车道内时才可手持使用，红灯路口不算
可以，只要一只手握方向盘
可以，如果是家人发的短信

explanation.en: Holding a device at a red light or stop sign is still prohibited; writing, sending, or reading messages while driving is barred.
explanation.zh: 在红灯或停车标志前手持设备仍然被禁止；驾驶时编写、发送或阅读信息也被禁止。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Distracted Driving Law / Hands-Free Mobile (Cell) Phone Use

q.en: What are the penalties for a first, second, and third violation of the hands-free law?
q.zh: 违反免提法的第一次、第二次和第三次处罚分别是什么？

en: Warning; $50; $100
$25; $50; license suspension
$100 fine; $250 fine plus a distracted-driving education program; $500 fine plus an insurance surcharge and the program
$500 for every offense
zh: 警告；50 美元；100 美元
25 美元；50 美元；吊销驾照
罚款 100 美元；罚款 250 美元并完成分心驾驶教育课程；罚款 500 美元并加保险附加费及完成课程
每次都是 500 美元

explanation.en: The fine ladder is $100, then $250 with the education program, then $500 with a surcharge and the program.
explanation.zh: 罚款阶梯为 100 美元，然后 250 美元加教育课程，然后 500 美元加附加费及课程。

source.section: Chapter 2 — Distracted Driving Law / Hands-Free Mobile (Cell) Phone Use

q.en: Your rear wheels start sliding to the left in a skid. What do you do with the steering wheel and pedals?
q.zh: 打滑时你的后轮向左滑动。方向盘和踏板应如何操作？

en: Turn the wheel in the direction of the skid (left), ease off the gas, shift to neutral, and do not hit the brakes
Turn the wheel right and brake firmly
Turn the wheel left and accelerate
Hold the wheel straight and pump the brakes
zh: 方向盘朝打滑方向（向左）打，松开油门，挂空挡，不要踩刹车
方向盘向右打并用力刹车
方向盘向左打并加速
保持方向盘笔直并点刹

explanation.en: In a skid: foot off the gas, neutral, no braking, steer into the skid.
explanation.zh: 打滑时：松油门、挂空挡、不刹车、朝打滑方向打方向。

q.en: Your brakes fail and your car does NOT have antilock brakes. What is the first technique to try?
q.zh: 你的刹车失灵且车辆没有防抱死刹车。应首先尝试什么方法？

en: Turn off the engine immediately
Pump the brake pedal several times rapidly to build up brake fluid pressure
Shift into reverse
Open the door and drag your foot
zh: 立即熄火
快速多次踩刹车踏板以建立制动液压力
挂入倒挡
开门用脚拖地

explanation.en: Without ABS, pump the pedal rapidly to build pressure; with ABS, never pump — then downshift and use the parking brake gently.
explanation.zh: 没有 ABS 时要快速点踩踏板建立压力；有 ABS 时绝不能点踩——然后降挡并轻拉手刹。

q.en: Your gas pedal sticks while you are driving. What should you do?
q.zh: 行驶中油门踏板卡住。你应该怎么做？

en: Reach down and pull it up with your hand while steering
Turn the wheel sharply to scrub speed
Put the car in neutral, press the brake to slow down, try to free the pedal with your foot, keep your eyes on the road, and pull over when safe
Shift into park
zh: 一边开方向一边伸手把踏板拉起来
急打方向来减速
挂空挡，踩刹车减速，用脚尝试松开踏板，眼睛看路，安全时靠边停车
挂入驻车挡

explanation.en: A stuck pedal calls for neutral, braking, freeing the pedal with your foot, and stopping off the road.
explanation.zh: 油门卡住时应挂空挡、刹车、用脚松开踏板，并在路边停下。

q.en: A vehicle is coming straight at you in your own lane. What is the recommended response?
q.zh: 一辆车在你的车道内正对着你驶来。推荐的应对是什么？

en: Move into their lane to pass
Stop in your lane and flash your lights
Speed up and swerve left at the last moment
Slow down, pull to the right, and sound your horn to alert the other driver
zh: 驶入对方车道绕过
停在自己车道内闪灯
加速并在最后一刻向左猛打方向
减速，靠右，并鸣笛提醒对方驾驶员

explanation.en: For a head-on threat: slow down, pull right, and sound the horn.
explanation.zh: 面对迎面来车：减速、靠右、鸣笛。

q.en: Your vehicle stalls on railroad tracks and a train is coming. What must everyone do?
q.zh: 你的车辆在铁轨上抛锚且火车正在驶来。所有人必须怎么做？

en: Get out immediately, move far from the tracks, run at a 45-degree angle away from the tracks toward the direction the train is coming from, and call 911
Stay in the car and keep trying to start it
Push the car off while the train approaches
Stand beside the car and wave at the train
zh: 立即下车，远离铁轨，朝火车驶来的方向沿与铁轨成 45 度角的方向跑开，并拨打 911
留在车里继续尝试发动
趁火车接近时推车
站在车旁向火车挥手

explanation.en: With a train coming, abandon the vehicle at once and escape at a 45-degree angle toward the train's direction to avoid wreckage.
explanation.zh: 火车驶来时要立即弃车，朝火车驶来方向沿 45 度角逃离，以避开残骸。

q.en: After a crash with no injuries, what does the Driver Removal Law require, and what information must drivers exchange?
q.zh: 发生无人受伤的事故后，驾驶员移车法（Driver Removal Law）要求什么，驾驶员必须交换哪些信息？

en: Leave cars in the travel lanes; exchange only phone numbers
Move vehicles out of travel lanes to a safe location; exchange name, address, license number, registration, and insurance information
Call a tow truck before moving anything; exchange nothing
Drive away if damage looks minor
zh: 把车留在行车道内；只交换电话号码
把车辆移出行车道到安全地点；交换姓名、地址、驾照号码、车辆登记和保险信息
在移动任何东西前先叫拖车；不交换任何信息
损坏看起来轻微就可以开走

explanation.en: Uninjured crashes: move out of travel lanes and exchange full identification, registration, and insurance details.
explanation.zh: 无人受伤的事故：移出行车道，并交换完整的身份、登记和保险信息。

q.en: By when, and for which crashes, must you file a written crash report with the RMV?
q.zh: 你必须在多久内、针对哪些事故向 RMV 提交书面事故报告？

en: Within 30 days, for any crash
Only crashes over $5,000 need a report, within a year
Within five days, for any crash causing injury or death or $1,000 or more in property damage
Reporting to your insurer is enough
zh: 30 天内，任何事故
只有超过 5,000 美元的事故才需要，一年内
五天内，任何造成伤亡或财产损失达 1,000 美元及以上的事故
向保险公司报备就足够了

explanation.en: Report injury, death, or $1,000-plus damage crashes to the RMV in writing within five days; telling only your insurer is not enough.
explanation.zh: 造成伤亡或损失达 1,000 美元以上的事故要在五天内书面报告 RMV；只告诉保险公司不够。

q.en: A quick tire check with a penny shows the top of Lincoln's head in the tread groove. What does that mean?
q.zh: 用一分硬币快速检查轮胎时，花纹沟里能看到林肯头像的顶部。这意味着什么？

en: The tread is at or below the 2/32-inch minimum — the tires are worn out
The tires have plenty of tread
The tires are overinflated
The penny test only works on snow tires
zh: 花纹已达到或低于 2/32 英寸的最低标准——轮胎已经磨光
轮胎花纹还很深
轮胎充气过量
硬币测试只适用于雪地胎

explanation.en: Visible top of Lincoln's head means tread depth is about 2/32 inch, the legal minimum; driving on worn tires is dangerous and illegal.
explanation.zh: 能看到林肯头像顶部说明花纹深度约为 2/32 英寸，即法定最低值；用磨光的轮胎行驶既危险又违法。

q.en: A school bus ahead has its red lights flashing and its stop sign extended. You are traveling in the opposite direction on an undivided road. What must you do?
q.zh: 前方校车红灯闪烁且停车牌已展开。你在无分隔道路上从对向驶来。你必须怎么做？

en: Pass slowly on the left
Stop only if children are visible in the road
Honk and proceed at 10 mph
Stop, and remain stopped until the lights stop flashing or the stop sign folds back
zh: 从左侧缓慢超越
只有看到路上有儿童才停车
鸣笛并以 10 英里/小时通过
停车，并保持停车直至红灯停止闪烁或停车牌收回

explanation.en: The duty to stop for a school bus applies from either side of the road.
explanation.zh: 无论从道路哪一侧驶来，都必须为校车停车。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Road Respect / Sharing the Road

q.en: What is the ONLY exception to stopping for a school bus with flashing red lights?
q.zh: 为红灯闪烁的校车停车义务，唯一的例外是什么？

en: When you are late for work
When the bus is empty
When the bus is on the other side of a divided highway with a barrier between the travel directions
When a police officer is nearby
zh: 上班迟到时
校车是空车时
校车位于有隔离带的分隔式公路另一侧时
附近有警察时

explanation.en: Only a barrier-divided highway between you and the bus removes the duty to stop.
explanation.zh: 只有你与校车之间有带隔离带的分隔式公路时，才免除停车义务。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Road Respect / Sharing the Road

q.en: What can a first violation of the school bus stopping law cost you?
q.zh: 首次违反校车停车法会有什么后果？

en: A warning only
A $25 fine
Six months in jail in all cases
A $250 fine and a possible license suspension
zh: 仅警告
罚款 25 美元
任何情况下监禁六个月
罚款 250 美元并可能吊销驾照

explanation.en: A first school-bus violation can bring a $250 fine and a license suspension.
explanation.zh: 首次违反校车停车规定可被罚 250 美元并吊销驾照。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Road Respect / Sharing the Road

q.en: You are passing a person riding a bicycle. How much space must you leave, and may you cross the center line to get it?
q.zh: 你正在超越一名骑行者。必须留出多少距离，可以为此跨越中心线吗？

en: At least 4 feet; if safe, you may use part of the next lane and cross the center line, while obeying the speed limit
At least 2 feet; never cross the center line
As much as fits in your own lane; space is optional
At least 6 feet; you must exceed the speed limit to pass quickly
zh: 至少 4 英尺；安全时可使用相邻车道的一部分并跨越中心线，同时遵守限速
至少 2 英尺；绝不能跨越中心线
自己车道内能留多少算多少；距离可选
至少 6 英尺；必须超速快速通过

explanation.en: Passing a vulnerable road user requires at least four feet, and crossing the center line is allowed if safe.
explanation.zh: 超越弱势道路使用者至少要留 4 英尺，安全时可以跨越中心线。

q.en: Which of these people count as 'vulnerable road users' under Massachusetts law?
q.zh: 根据马萨诸塞州法律，下列哪些人属于“弱势道路使用者”？

en: Only pedestrians
Pedestrians, bicyclists, roadside workers, wheelchair users, and people on scooters or skateboards, among others
Only children under 12
Only people in marked crosswalks
zh: 只有行人
包括行人、骑行者、道路作业人员、轮椅使用者以及滑板车或滑板使用者等
只有 12 岁以下儿童
只有在人行横道标记内的人

explanation.en: The law's list is broad: pedestrians, workers, bicyclists, mobility-device users, scooter and skateboard users, and more.
explanation.zh: 该法名单很广：行人、作业人员、骑行者、行动辅助设备使用者、滑板车和滑板使用者等。

q.en: A pedestrian with a white cane is crossing the street ahead. What does the White Cane Law require?
q.zh: 一名手持白手杖的行人正在前方过街。白手杖法要求什么？

en: Slow down and steer around them
Honk once so they know you are there
Come to a complete stop, remain stopped until the person has safely crossed, and do not honk or wave them on
Pass the stopped car beside you to get through faster
zh: 减速并绕开对方
鸣笛一次让对方知道你在那里
完全停稳，保持停车直至对方安全过街，且不要鸣笛或挥手催促
超越旁边停着的车以便更快通过

explanation.en: Drivers must stop completely for a blind pedestrian and stay stopped until the crossing is finished.
explanation.zh: 驾驶员必须为盲人行人完全停车，并保持停车直至其过街完成。

q.en: Your car is beside a stopped vehicle at a crosswalk on a multi-lane road. What must you do before passing it?
q.zh: 在多车道道路的人行横道处，你旁边有一辆停着的车。超越它之前你必须怎么做？

en: Check for pedestrians first — never pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk without checking
Pass quickly before pedestrians appear
Honk and pass at normal speed
Pass on the shoulder
zh: 先检查是否有行人——绝不能不查看就超越在人行横道停车的车辆
在行人出现前快速超越
鸣笛并以正常速度超越
从路肩超越

explanation.en: A vehicle stopped at a crosswalk may be hiding a pedestrian; never pass it without checking.
explanation.zh: 在人行横道停车的车辆可能挡住行人；不查看绝不能超越。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Road Respect / Sharing the Road

q.en: An ambulance with siren and flashing lights approaches from behind. What must you do?
q.zh: 一辆鸣笛并闪灯的救护车从后方驶来。你必须怎么做？

en: Speed up to stay ahead of it
Pull as close as possible to the right side of the road and stop until it has passed — slow rolling is not acceptable
Stop immediately wherever you are, even in the middle of an intersection
Pull to the left to open the right lane
zh: 加速保持在它前面
尽量靠道路右侧并停车，直至其通过——缓慢滚动不行
立即在原地停车，哪怕在路口中央
靠左以让出右侧车道

explanation.en: Yield to a moving emergency vehicle by pulling right and stopping fully; if in an intersection, drive through first, then pull over.
explanation.zh: 为移动中的应急车辆让行要靠右并完全停车；在路口内时先驶出路口再靠边。

q.en: How close may you follow behind a fire truck that is responding to an alarm?
q.zh: 你可以跟在一辆正在响应警报的消防车后面多近？

en: Within 100 feet
Within 200 feet
No closer than 300 feet
Following distance does not apply to emergency vehicles
zh: 100 英尺以内
200 英尺以内
不得近于 300 英尺
跟车距离不适用于应急车辆

explanation.en: Following within 300 feet of an emergency vehicle responding to an alarm is illegal.
explanation.zh: 跟在响应警报的应急车辆后 300 英尺以内是违法的。

q.en: On a four-lane highway (two lanes each way), a tow truck with flashing lights is stopped on the right shoulder. Under the Move Over law, what must you do?
q.zh: 在四车道高速公路（每向两车道）上，一辆闪灯的拖车停在右侧路肩。根据让路法（Move Over），你必须怎么做？

en: Nothing — the law covers only police cars
Stop completely in your lane
Speed up to pass the scene quickly
Move over to a lane not next to the stopped vehicle if safe, and in any case slow to a reasonable and safe speed with caution
zh: 什么都不用做——该法只适用于警车
在自己车道内完全停车
加速快速通过现场
安全时换到不与停着的车辆相邻的车道，且无论如何要谨慎地减至合理安全的速度

explanation.en: The Move Over law covers emergency, highway, and recovery vehicles; move over a lane when possible, otherwise slow down.
explanation.zh: 让路法适用于应急、公路养护和救援车辆；能换道时换道，否则减速。

q.en: If you cannot see a truck's rearview mirrors while following it, what does that mean?
q.zh: 跟在大卡车后时若你看不到它的后视镜，这意味着什么？

en: You are in the truck's blind spot and following too closely — you are losing the safety cushion you need
The truck driver can see you clearly
Your headlights are off
The truck is about to turn
zh: 你在卡车的盲区内且跟得太近——你正在失去需要的安全缓冲
卡车司机能清楚看到你
你的大灯没开
卡车即将转弯

explanation.en: If you cannot see a truck's mirrors, the truck driver cannot see you.
explanation.zh: 若你看不到卡车的后视镜，卡车司机也看不到你。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Road Respect / Sharing the Road

q.en: A fully loaded tractor-trailer may need how much stopping distance compared with a passenger car?
q.zh: 一辆满载的牵引挂车所需制动距离与乘用车相比如何？

en: About half as much
Up to twice as much, especially on wet or icy roads
About the same
Trucks always stop faster because of air brakes
zh: 约一半
可达两倍，尤其在湿滑或结冰路面
大致相同
卡车因气刹总是停得更快

explanation.en: Large trucks may need twice the stopping distance of a car; never cut in front of one and slow down.
explanation.zh: 大卡车制动距离可达小汽车的两倍；绝不能切到其前方然后减速。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Road Respect / Sharing the Road

q.en: You have just passed a bicyclist and want to make a right turn at the next driveway. What rule applies?
q.zh: 你刚超越一名骑行者，想在下一个车道入口右转。适用哪条规则？

en: Turn immediately; the bicyclist must stop for you
Honk so the bicyclist moves over
You may turn only when you are at a safe distance from the bicyclist and can turn at a reasonable, proper speed; never cut back right until safely past
Bicyclists always yield to turning cars
zh: 立即转弯；骑行者必须为你停下
鸣笛让骑行者靠边
只有与骑行者保持安全距离、能以合理适当的速度转弯时才可转；未安全超越前绝不能切回右侧
骑行者永远让转弯车辆

explanation.en: After passing a bicycle you must not cut it off, and right turns in front of one require a safe distance and proper speed.
explanation.zh: 超越自行车后不得切断其路线，在骑行者前方右转需保持安全距离和适当速度。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Laws for Bicyclists and Motorists in the Presence of Bicyclists

q.en: You are about to open your car door while parked on a street with bicycle traffic. What is the safe method, and what is the fine for opening a door into an oncoming bicycle?
q.zh: 你停在有自行车通行的街道上准备开车门。安全方法是什么，将车门开向驶来的自行车会被罚多少？

en: Check mirrors and use your far hand to open the door (the 'Dutch Reach'); the fine can be up to $100
Open quickly with the near hand; no fine exists
Open the door only halfway; fine is $25
Passengers may open doors without checking; fine is $500
zh: 看后视镜并用远侧手开门（“荷兰式伸手”）；罚款可达 100 美元
用近侧手快速开门；没有罚款
只开一半；罚款 25 美元
乘客开门无需查看；罚款 500 美元

explanation.en: The Dutch Reach forces you to turn and look; dooring a bicyclist can be fined up to $100.
explanation.zh: 荷兰式伸手法迫使你转身查看；开门撞向骑行者可被罚最高 100 美元。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Laws for Bicyclists and Motorists in the Presence of Bicyclists

q.en: At a red light there is a green bicycle box painted before the crosswalk, and it is empty. Where must you stop?
q.zh: 红灯时，人行横道前画有绿色的自行车候车区（bicycle box），且里面是空的。你必须停在哪里？

en: Inside the box, since it is empty
Behind the bicycle box, even when it is empty, and wait for the green light
On the crosswalk, past the box
Bicycle boxes are only suggestions for cars
zh: 里面是空的，可以停在框内
停在自行车候车区之后，即使是空的，并等绿灯
停在人行横道上、越过候车区
自行车候车区对汽车只是建议

explanation.en: Drivers must stop behind a bicycle box at a red light whether or not a bicyclist is in it.
explanation.zh: 红灯时无论候车区内有无骑行者，驾驶员都必须停在其后。

q.en: A trolley is stopped letting passengers off. How close may you drive to its passenger step?
q.zh: 一辆有轨电车正停着让乘客下车。你可以驶近其乘客踏板到什么距离？

en: No closer than 3 feet
You may pass within inches if you slow down
No closer than 8 feet while it is loading or unloading
Distance rules do not apply to trolleys
zh: 不得近于 3 英尺
减速就可以贴着通过
上下客时不得近于 8 英尺
电车不适用距离规则

explanation.en: State law bars driving within eight feet of a trolley step while passengers are getting on or off.
explanation.zh: 州法禁止在电车上下客时驶入其踏板 8 英尺以内。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Road Respect / Sharing the Road

q.en: You are driving behind a funeral procession on a multi-lane highway. Which action is prohibited for non-participants?
q.zh: 你在多车道高速公路上跟在送葬车队后面。非车队成员被禁止做哪件事？

en: Driving with headlights on
Slowing down near the procession
Yielding to the procession at an intersection
Passing the procession on its right, unless the procession is in the far left lane
zh: 打开大灯行驶
在车队附近减速
在路口给车队让行
从车队右侧超越，除非车队在最左侧车道

explanation.en: Non-participants may not cut between procession vehicles, join, or pass on the right unless the procession is in the far left lane.
explanation.zh: 非车队成员不得插入车队车辆之间、加入车队，或从右侧超越（除非车队在最左侧车道）。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Road Respect / Sharing the Road

q.en: A pedestrian is already in the crosswalk when the countdown timer reaches zero. Who has the right-of-way?
q.zh: 倒计时到零时，一名行人已经在人行横道内。谁有路权？

en: The pedestrian already in the crosswalk has the right-of-way
The turning driver
Whoever reaches the middle first
The pedestrian must run back to the curb
zh: 已在人行横道内的行人拥有路权
转弯的驾驶员
谁先到中间谁先
行人必须跑回路边

explanation.en: Pedestrians already in the crosswalk when the countdown ends keep the right-of-way, and drivers must yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk in their path.
explanation.zh: 倒计时结束时已在横道内的行人保持路权，驾驶员必须给其行进路线横道内的行人让行。

source.section: Chapter 4 — Rules for Pedestrians / Pedestrian Signals

q.en: At what blood alcohol content is a driver operating above the legal limit in Massachusetts?
q.zh: 在马萨诸塞州，血液酒精浓度（BAC）达到多少即属超限驾驶？

en: 0.10 or higher
Any detectable amount for all drivers
0.08 or higher
zh: 0.10 或更高
所有驾驶员只要检出即算
0.08 或更高

explanation.en: A BAC of 0.08 or higher is above the legal limit for all drivers.
explanation.zh: BAC 达 0.08 或更高对所有驾驶员都属超限。

q.en: Massachusetts has a zero-tolerance rule for drivers under 21. Penalties can begin at what BAC?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞州对 21 岁以下驾驶员实行零容忍。BAC 达到多少就可能面临处罚？

en: 0.00 only — any reading below 0.02 is ignored
zh: 只有 0.00——低于 0.02 的读数一律忽略

explanation.en: Drivers under 21 face penalties for a BAC as low as 0.02.
explanation.zh: 21 岁以下驾驶员 BAC 低至 0.02 就会面临处罚。

q.en: What does the Implied Consent Law mean for a licensed Massachusetts driver?
q.zh: 默示同意法（Implied Consent Law）对持照的马萨诸塞州驾驶员意味着什么？

en: The driver agrees in advance to a breath or blood test in certain cases, such as after an arrest for suspected OUI
The driver consents to any search of the vehicle at any time
Police never need a reason to test any driver
Consent applies only to drivers under 21
zh: 驾驶员预先同意在某些情况下（如因涉嫌酒驾被捕后）接受呼气或血液检测
驾驶员同意任何时候搜查其车辆
警察无需任何理由即可检测任何驾驶员
该同意仅适用于 21 岁以下驾驶员

explanation.en: By holding a license, a driver consents to a breathalyzer or blood test in the cases the law describes.
explanation.zh: 持有驾照即表示同意在法律所述情况下接受呼气或血液检测。

q.en: After a stop, your BAC is over the limit — or you refuse the breath or blood test. What happens to your license on the spot?
q.zh: 被拦下后，你的 BAC 超限——或者你拒绝呼气或血液检测。你的驾照当场会怎样？

en: Nothing until a court hearing months later
The officer must take your license and you get a notice of suspension that is effective immediately
You keep the license but receive a warning letter
Only the registration is taken
zh: 几个月后上法庭前什么都不会发生
警察必须收走你的驾照，你会收到立即生效的吊销通知
你保留驾照，只收到警告信
只收走车辆登记

explanation.en: Over-limit BAC or a refusal means the officer takes the license and suspension starts immediately.
explanation.zh: BAC 超限或拒绝检测，警察会收走驾照，吊销立即生效。

q.en: A driver over 21 with no prior OUI offenses refuses a chemical test. How long is the license suspension for the refusal?
q.zh: 一名 21 岁以上、无酒驾前科的驾驶员拒绝化学检测。因拒绝检测吊销驾照多久？

en: 30 days
90 days
180 days
Five years
zh: 五年

explanation.en: For an adult with no prior OUI offense, refusal brings a 180-day suspension; priors raise it to three years, five years, then lifetime.
explanation.zh: 无前科的成年人拒绝检测吊销 180 天；有前科则依次升至三年、五年乃至终身。

source.section: Chapter 3 — License Suspension Periods for Failed / Refused Chemical Tests

q.en: A driver over 21 fails a chemical test (BAC 0.08 or more) with no court result yet. What is the suspension from the failed test itself?
q.zh: 一名 21 岁以上驾驶员化学检测不合格（BAC 0.08 或以上），法院尚无结果。仅因检测不合格的吊销期是多久？

en: One year automatically
180 days plus another year
No suspension until conviction
30 days, or until the court case concludes, whichever is shorter
zh: 自动一年
180 天再加一年
定罪前不吊销
30 天，或到法院案件结束为止，以较短者为准

explanation.en: For drivers over 21, a failed test suspends the license for 30 days or until the case ends, whichever is shorter.
explanation.zh: 21 岁以上者检测不合格吊销 30 天或至案件结束，以较短者为准。

source.section: Chapter 3 — License Suspension Periods for Failed / Refused Chemical Tests

q.en: How long is the license suspension after a FIRST OUI conviction?
q.zh: 第一次酒驾（OUI）定罪后，驾照吊销多久？

en: One year
30 days
90 days
Two years
zh: 一年
两年

explanation.en: A first OUI conviction carries a one-year suspension; later convictions bring two, eight, and ten years, then lifetime.
explanation.zh: 第一次酒驾定罪吊销一年；后续定罪依次为两年、八年、十年，然后终身。

q.en: What fine range applies to a first OUI conviction?
q.zh: 第一次酒驾定罪的罚款范围是多少？

en: $500 to $5,000, with up to two and a half years in prison
No fine on a first offense
zh: 500 至 5,000 美元，并可判最高两年半监禁
初犯不罚款

explanation.en: First-offense OUI: $500–$5,000 fine and up to 2½ years; a court may allow an alcohol education program to shorten the suspension.
explanation.zh: 初犯酒驾：罚款 500 至 5,000 美元并可判最高两年半；法院可允许以酒精教育课程缩短吊销期。

q.en: Which drinks contain roughly the same amount of alcohol (about half an ounce)?
q.zh: 下列哪些饮品所含酒精量大致相同（约半盎司）？

en: A 12-ounce beer and two glasses of wine
Only hard liquor counts as alcohol
A 12-ounce beer, a 5-ounce glass of wine, and a 1.5-ounce serving of 80-proof liquor
Wine contains no alcohol that affects driving
zh: 一杯 12 盎司啤酒和两杯葡萄酒
只有烈酒才算酒精
一杯 12 盎司啤酒、一杯 5 盎司葡萄酒和一份 1.5 盎司 80 度烈酒
葡萄酒不含影响驾驶的酒精

explanation.en: Beer, wine, and liquor servings above each carry about the same alcohol; what matters is total alcohol over time.
explanation.zh: 上述啤酒、葡萄酒和烈酒的份量酒精含量大致相同；关键是一段时间内摄入的酒精总量。

q.en: After drinking, which of these will actually lower your BAC?
q.zh: 饮酒后，下列哪种做法真能降低你的 BAC？

en: Drinking black coffee
Taking a cold shower
Exercising or eating a meal
Only time — nothing speeds up how fast alcohol leaves your body
zh: 喝黑咖啡
洗冷水澡
运动或吃一顿饭
只有时间——没有任何办法能加快酒精排出身体的速度

explanation.en: Coffee, showers, exercise, and food may make you feel alert but do not change how quickly alcohol leaves the body.
explanation.zh: 咖啡、洗澡、运动和食物可能让你感觉清醒，但不会改变酒精排出的速度。

q.en: How does alcohol affect a driver, according to the manual's facts on impairment?
q.zh: 根据手册关于损害的事实，酒精如何影响驾驶员？

en: It improves reaction time on short trips
It is a depressant: it slows reflexes, lengthens reaction time, distorts vision and judgment, and can make a driver overconfident
It affects only very drunk drivers
It only affects vision at night
zh: 它在短途时能提高反应速度
它是抑制剂：减慢反射、延长反应时间、扭曲视觉和判断力，并可能让驾驶员过度自信
它只影响醉得很厉害的驾驶员
它只在夜间影响视觉

explanation.en: Even small amounts of alcohol impair the vision, reaction time, coordination, and judgment driving requires.
explanation.zh: 即使少量酒精也会损害驾驶所需的视觉、反应时间、协调能力和判断力。

q.en: A driver with two or more OUI offenses becomes eligible for a hardship license. What device is required?
q.zh: 有两次或以上酒驾记录的驾驶员获得困难驾照（hardship license）资格时，必须安装什么设备？

en: A speed governor set by the RMV
A dashboard camera
An Ignition Interlock Device, at the driver's expense, during the hardship period and for two years after reinstatement
Nothing extra is required
zh: 由 RMV 设定的限速器
行车记录仪
点火联锁装置，费用自理，在困难驾照期间及恢复驾照后两年内使用
不需要任何额外设备

explanation.en: Two or more OUI offenses trigger the Ignition Interlock requirement for hardship driving and reinstatement.
explanation.zh: 两次或以上酒驾会触发点火联锁要求，适用于困难驾驶和恢复驾照。

q.en: A 19-year-old is carrying an unopened bottle of wine in the car, riding alone. What does Massachusetts law say?
q.zh: 一名 19 岁的人独自乘车，车里有一瓶未开封的葡萄酒。马萨诸塞州法律如何规定？

en: Unopened containers are always legal
Only drinking it in the car is illegal
Transporting is fine if the bottle is in the trunk in all cases
It is illegal for someone under 21 to possess, carry, or transport alcohol unless accompanied by a parent or guardian; the license can be suspended 90 days to one year
zh: 未开封的容器永远合法
只有在车里喝才违法
任何情况下放在后备箱运输都可以
21 岁以下者持有、携带或运输酒精属违法，除非有父母或监护人陪同；驾照可被吊销 90 天至一年

explanation.en: Under-21 possession or transport of alcohol without a parent or guardian present risks a 90-day to one-year suspension.
explanation.zh: 21 岁以下者在无父母或监护人陪同时持有或运输酒精，可能被吊销 90 天至一年。

q.en: A passenger in the back seat holds an open can of beer while you drive. Is that a problem under the Open Container Law?
q.zh: 你驾驶时，后排乘客拿着一罐打开的啤酒。根据开容器法（Open Container Law），这有问题吗？

en: Yes — you may not have an open alcoholic drink inside the vehicle even if someone else is holding it; the fine is $100 to $500
No — passengers may hold open containers
Only if the passenger is under 21
Only on highways
zh: 有——车内不得有打开的酒精饮料，即使是别人拿着；罚款 100 至 500 美元
没有——乘客可以拿打开的容器
只有乘客未满 21 岁才有问题
只在高速公路上

explanation.en: An open container anywhere in the vehicle violates the law, whoever is holding it.
explanation.zh: 车内任何位置有打开的容器都违法，无论是谁拿着。

q.en: Does Massachusetts OUI law cover marijuana and prescription medicines?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞州酒驾法是否涵盖大麻和处方药？

en: No — OUI is alcohol only
Yes — operating under the influence of marijuana is a criminal offense, and impairment by any substance, including prescription or over-the-counter drugs, is illegal
Only if the drugs are illegal to possess
Only marijuana edibles are covered
zh: 不涵盖——OUI 只指酒精
涵盖——在大麻影响下驾驶是刑事犯罪，受任何物质（包括处方药或非处方药）损害而驾驶均属违法
只有非法持有的药物才涵盖
只涵盖大麻食品

explanation.en: The same OUI penalties apply to marijuana and other impairing drugs and medicines.
explanation.zh: 同样的 OUI 处罚适用于大麻及其它致损药物和药品。

q.en: What happens if you mix alcohol with another drug before driving?
q.zh: 驾驶前把酒精与另一种药物混合使用会怎样？

en: The effects cancel out
Only the drug's label matters
Combining alcohol with other drugs dramatically increases the negative effects — a fatal mistake to mix with driving
It is legal if the drug was prescribed
zh: 效果相互抵消
只需看药物标签
酒精与其它药物混合会大幅放大负面效果——与驾驶混合是致命错误
只要药物是处方开的就合法

explanation.en: Mixing alcohol with other drugs multiplies impairment; never combine them with driving.
explanation.zh: 酒精与其它药物混合会倍增损害；绝不能与驾驶混合。

q.en: What is the minimum age to apply for a Class D learner's permit in Massachusetts?
q.zh: 在马萨诸塞州，申请 D 类学习驾照的最低年龄是多少？

en: 15 and a half
zh: 15 岁半

explanation.en: You must be at least 16 to apply for a Class D or Class M learner's permit, and no one under 16 may drive in Massachusetts at all.
explanation.zh: 申请 D 类或 M 类学习驾照必须年满 16 岁，且未满 16 岁者根本不能在马萨诸塞州驾驶。

q.en: How many questions are on the Class D learner's permit exam, how many must you answer correctly, and how much time do you get?
q.zh: D 类学习驾照考试有多少道题、要答对多少、时间多久？

en: 25 questions; 20 correct; 60 minutes
25 questions; 18 correct; 25 minutes
50 questions; 40 correct; 50 minutes
30 questions; 21 correct; 30 minutes
zh: 25 道题；答对 20 道；60 分钟
25 道题；答对 18 道；25 分钟
50 道题；答对 40 道；50 分钟
30 道题；答对 21 道；30 分钟

explanation.en: The permit exam is 25 multiple-choice questions in 25 minutes, and 18 correct answers pass.
explanation.zh: 学习驾照考试为 25 道选择题、25 分钟，答对 18 道即通过。

q.en: Which license class covers ordinary passenger vehicles such as cars, SUVs, and family vans?
q.zh: 哪一类驾照涵盖汽车、SUV 和家庭厢式车等普通乘用车辆？

en: Class A
Class B
Class D
Class C
zh: A 类
B 类
D 类
C 类

explanation.en: Class D is the common passenger-vehicle license; A, B, and C are commercial classes and M is motorcycles.
explanation.zh: D 类是普通乘用车驾照；A、B、C 是商用类，M 类是摩托车。

q.en: A Class B license holder may operate which vehicles (with proper endorsements)?
q.zh: B 类驾照持有人可以驾驶哪些车辆（在有适当签注时）？

en: Only motorcycles
Only vehicles under 10,000 pounds
Any combination with a towed unit over 10,000 pounds
Any single vehicle with a GVWR of 26,001 pounds or more, or such a vehicle towing up to 10,000 pounds GVWR — and all Class C and D vehicles
zh: 只有摩托车
只有 10,000 磅以下的车辆
任何被牵引单元超过 10,000 磅的组合车辆
任何总重（GVWR）达 26,001 磅或以上的单一车辆，或牵引 GVWR 不超过 10,000 磅车辆的此类车辆——以及所有 C 类和 D 类车辆

explanation.en: Class B covers heavy single vehicles and includes Class C and D privileges; the heavy combination definition belongs to Class A.
explanation.zh: B 类涵盖重型单一车辆并包括 C 类和 D 类权限；重型组合车辆属于 A 类。

q.en: For how long is a Massachusetts driver's license valid, and when does it usually expire?
q.zh: 马萨诸塞州驾照有效期多长，通常何时到期？

en: A maximum of five years; typically on your birthday
Three years; on January 1
Ten years; on the issue date
Five years; on the date you moved to Massachusetts
zh: 最长五年；通常在你的生日到期
三年；1 月 1 日
十年；在签发日
五年；在你迁入马萨诸塞州之日

explanation.en: Licenses run a maximum of five years and typically expire on the holder's birthday; renewal is possible up to a year early.
explanation.zh: 驾照最长有效五年，通常在持有人生日到期；可提前至一年续期。

q.en: You just became a Massachusetts resident and hold a valid license from another state. How long is your grace period to get a Massachusetts license?
q.zh: 你刚成为马萨诸塞州居民并持有其它州的有效驾照。换取马萨诸塞州驾照的宽限期是多久？

en: 30 days
There is no grace period — you must obtain a Massachusetts license to keep driving
60 days
Six months
zh: 没有宽限期——必须取得马萨诸塞州驾照才能继续驾驶
六个月

explanation.en: New residents must get a Massachusetts license with no grace period.
explanation.zh: 新居民必须取得马萨诸塞州驾照，没有宽限期。

q.en: What vision standard must you meet for a full Class D license?
q.zh: 获得完整 D 类驾照必须达到什么视力标准？

en: 20/20 in both eyes
20/70 in the better eye is enough for a full license
At least 20/40 corrected acuity in the better eye and at least 120 degrees of horizontal peripheral vision with both eyes
Only color vision is tested
zh: 较好眼 20/70 就够拿完整驾照
较好眼矫正视力至少 20/40，双眼水平周边视野至少 120 度
只测色觉

explanation.en: Corrected vision between 20/50 and 20/70 may qualify only for a daylight-only license.
explanation.zh: 矫正视力在 20/50 至 20/70 之间可能只符合仅限日间驾驶的驾照。

q.en: If you pass the vision screening only because you wear glasses, what appears on your license?
q.zh: 若你只是因为戴眼镜才通过视力筛查，你的驾照上会出现什么？

en: A 'Corrective Lenses' restriction — code letter B — and you must wear your lenses when you drive
Nothing
A daylight-only restriction in all cases
A note that glasses are optional
zh: “矫正镜片”限制——代码字母 B——驾驶时必须佩戴镜片
什么都没有
任何情况下都是仅限日间限制
一条眼镜可选的备注

explanation.en: Passing with lenses adds restriction B; restriction G is daylight only.
explanation.zh: 戴镜片通过会加上 B 限制；G 才是仅限日间。

q.en: Who may supervise a Class D learner's permit holder while they practice?
q.zh: D 类学习驾照持有人练习时，谁可以陪同监督？

en: Any licensed driver over 18
A licensed operator seated beside the permit holder who is at least 21 years old with at least one year of driving experience
A parent only, regardless of experience
The permit holder may practice alone after 30 days
zh: 任何 18 岁以上的持照驾驶员
坐在学习者旁边的持照驾驶员，年满 21 岁且有至少一年驾驶经验
只能是父母，无论经验如何
持有 30 天后可独自练习

explanation.en: The supervisor must sit beside the learner, be at least 21, hold a valid license, and have at least a year of driving experience.
explanation.zh: 监督者必须坐在学习者旁边、年满 21 岁、持有效驾照且有至少一年驾驶经验。

q.en: A permit holder who is under 18 wants to drive at 2 a.m. When is that allowed?
q.zh: 一名未满 18 岁的学习驾照持有人想在凌晨 2 点开车。什么时候允许？

en: Never
Whenever the regular supervisor is present
Only when accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who is a validly licensed operator with at least one year of driving experience
On weekends only
zh: 绝不允许
只要通常的监督者在场
只有在有父母或法定监护人陪同时——对方须是持照且有至少一年驾驶经验的驾驶员
仅限周末

explanation.en: Under-18 permit holders may not drive between midnight and 5 a.m. without a parent or legal guardian meeting the license and experience conditions.
explanation.zh: 未满 18 岁的学习者在午夜至凌晨 5 点之间不得驾驶，除非有符合执照和经验条件的父母或监护人陪同。

q.en: What must a 16-and-a-half to 18-year-old complete before taking the road test for a Junior Operator License?
q.zh: 16 岁半至 18 岁的人在参加初级驾驶员驾照（JOL）路考前必须完成什么？

en: Only the permit exam
100 hours of night driving only
A college driving course

Hold a permit at least six consecutive months, keep a clean record for six months, finish an approved driver education program, and complete 40 hours of supervised driving (30 with a skills development program)
zh: 只有学习考试
仅 100 小时夜间驾驶
大学驾驶课程
持有学习驾照至少连续六个月、保持六个月良好记录、完成批准的驾驶教育课程，并完成 40 小时监督驾驶（参加技能提升课程则为 30 小时）

explanation.en: Driver education itself is 30 classroom hours, 12 behind-the-wheel hours, and 6 hours observing other students.
explanation.zh: 驾驶教育本身包括 30 小时课堂、12 小时实驾和 6 小时观摩其他学员。

q.en: During the first six months with a Junior Operator License, which passengers may ride with the junior operator without a qualifying adult beside them?
q.zh: 持有 JOL 的头六个月，在没有合格成年人坐在旁边的陪同时，哪些乘客可以乘坐初级驾驶员的车？

en: Any friends, if they are students
No passengers at all, including family
Coworkers under 18, for work trips only
Only the driver themselves or an immediate family member under 18 — other under-18 passengers require a licensed driver age 21+ with at least one year of experience seated beside the junior operator
zh: 任何朋友，只要是学生
任何人都不能坐，包括家人
18 岁以下同事，仅限工作出行
只有驾驶员本人或 18 岁以下的直系亲属——其它 18 岁以下乘客需要有持照、21 岁以上且有至少一年经验的驾驶员坐在旁边陪同

explanation.en: The first-six-month passenger restriction bars under-18 passengers other than the driver or immediate family, unless the qualifying adult is beside the driver.
explanation.zh: 头六个月乘客限制禁止搭载驾驶员本人或直系亲属以外的 18 岁以下乘客，除非有合格成年人坐在旁边。

q.en: What are the suspension penalties for a Junior Operator who violates the passenger or night restriction?
q.zh: 初级驾驶员违反乘客或夜间限制的吊销处罚是什么？

en: A $25 fine only
60 days for a first offense, 180 days for a second, and one year for later offenses
30 days for every offense
No suspension until age 18
zh: 仅罚款 25 美元
初犯 60 天，第二次 180 天，之后一年
每次都是 30 天
18 岁前不吊销

explanation.en: Second and later offenses also require a Driver Attitudinal Retraining course.
explanation.zh: 第二次及以后的违例还须完成驾驶态度再培训课程。

q.en: A Junior Operator is caught speeding for the first time. What suspension follows?
q.zh: 初级驾驶员第一次超速被抓。会有什么吊销处罚？

en: 30 days
One year
90 days
None — only a fine
zh: 一年
没有——只有罚款

explanation.en: For a JOL holder, a first speeding offense brings a 90-day suspension; a later one brings a year. Drag racing brings one year, then three.
explanation.zh: JOL 持有者第一次超速吊销 90 天，之后为一年；飙车为一年，然后三年。

q.en: For a Junior Operator, driving between 12:30 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. is allowed only when…
q.zh: 对初级驾驶员而言，在凌晨 12:30 至 5:00 之间驾驶，仅在……时允许

en: Accompanied by one of their parents or their legal guardian
They are driving to work
They have held the JOL for three months
They drive on highways only
zh: 有父母之一或法定监护人陪同时
开车去上班时
持有 JOL 满三个月时
只在高速公路上驾驶时

explanation.en: Breaking the JOL night rule without a parent or guardian can be charged as driving without a license, a criminal violation.
explanation.zh: 无父母或监护人陪同违反 JOL 夜间规定，可被控无证驾驶，属刑事违规。

q.en: What is a 'surchargeable event'?
q.zh: 什么是“附加费事件”（surchargeable event）？

en: Any trip through a toll plaza
A motor vehicle violation or an at-fault crash, which counts toward a possible license suspension and affects insurance
Only a parking ticket
A vehicle inspection failure
zh: 任何经过收费站的行程
机动车违规或有过错事故，会计入可能的驾照吊销并影响保险
只有停车罚单
车辆年检不合格

explanation.en: Violations and at-fault crashes are surchargeable events; most out-of-state convictions count as if they happened in Massachusetts.
explanation.zh: 违规和有过错事故属于附加费事件；大多数外州定罪按发生在马萨诸塞州计算。

q.en: A driver collects three surchargeable events within two years. What must they do, and by when?
q.zh: 一名驾驶员在两年内累积三个附加费事件。必须做什么、在多久内？

en: Nothing until five events
Retake the road test within a year
Complete the Massachusetts Driver Retraining Course within 90 days, or the license is suspended until it is completed
Pay a $500 fee within 20 days
zh: 五个事件前什么都不用做
一年内重考路考
在 90 天内完成马萨诸塞州驾驶员再培训课程，否则驾照将被吊销直至完成
20 天内缴纳 500 美元

explanation.en: The retraining course is eight hours, in two four-hour sessions, and it does not erase the offenses from the record.
explanation.zh: 再培训课程为八小时、分两次四小时完成，且不会抹除记录上的违例。

q.en: How many surchargeable events within three years trigger an automatic 60-day license suspension?
q.zh: 三年内多少个附加费事件会触发自动吊销驾照 60 天？

en: Three
Five
Ten
Seven
zh: 三个
五个
十个
七个

explanation.en: Seven surchargeable events in three years means an automatic 60-day suspension.
explanation.zh: 三年内七个附加费事件即自动吊销 60 天。

q.en: Three speeding violations within a 12-month period result in what?
q.zh: 12 个月内三次超速违规会导致什么？

en: An automatic 30-day license suspension
A warning letter
A $100 fine only
Mandatory community service
zh: 自动吊销驾照 30 天
一封警告信
仅罚款 100 美元
强制社区服务

explanation.en: Three speeding findings in a year suspend the license for 30 days.
explanation.zh: 一年内三次超速即吊销驾照 30 天。

q.en: You receive a citation for a civil motor vehicle infraction. Within how many days must you pay the fine or request a hearing, and which unpaid items can block license renewal?
q.zh: 你收到一张民事机动车违规传票。必须在多少天内缴纳罚款或申请听证，哪些未缴款项会阻止驾照续期？

en: 90 days; nothing blocks renewal
20 days; unpaid parking fines, excise taxes, outstanding warrants, and unpaid toll violations can block renewal
10 days; only unpaid speeding fines block renewal
Civil citations never affect a license
zh: 90 天； 没有任何事项能阻止续期
20 天；未缴停车罚款、消费税、未决逮捕令及未缴通行费都可阻止续期
10 天；只有未缴超速罚款阻止续期
民事传票从不影响驾照

explanation.en: A civil citation gives you 20 days to pay or request a hearing; ignoring it means being found responsible, a late fee, and possible suspension.
explanation.zh: 民事传票给你 20 天缴纳或申请听证；置之不理会被判定有责、加收滞纳金并可能被吊销。

source.section: Chapter 3 — Civil Motor Vehicle Infractions / License Nonrenewal
